highlights: Glassmorphism panels: backdrop-filter: blur(45px) with frost-white-intense (rgba(255,255,255,0.8)) for light mode headers and floating cards
Glassmorphism panels: backdrop-filter: blur(45px) with frost-grey-intense (rgba(89,90,90,0.6)) for dark mode headers and overlays
Soft box shadows on popups: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)
Multiple shadow layers on cards: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)
Custom grid dot pattern overlay with radial gradient dots (white 1px, transparent 1.5px) at 50% opacity with mix-blend-difference
Radial gradient masks for circular reveals at 165px (mobile) and 240px (desktop) centered at 50% 40%
Dynamic horizontal band mask using CSS variables for reveal animations
Consent popup exterior border with 8px border-radius and hsl(0deg 0% 100% / 80%) background
Frost effect variations: frost-white-low (5% opacity), frost-white-intense (80% opacity), frost-grey-low (5% opacity), frost-grey-intense (60% opacity)
Transition animations: 1.25s cubic-bezier(0.74,0,0.19,0.99) for band effects
Selection highlight: background greyscale-900 (#595A5A) with white text
